Description.Name: RAC/5 Ammo
Description.Details: Caseless autocannon ammunition was developed by the Federated Commonwealth to provide more ammunition. Instead of a standard metal or plastic shell casing filled with propellant, the caseless autocannon round had the propellant 'packed' around the projectile. Upon receiving a Critical Hit, any remaining ammunition stored inside an Ammo Bin will explode dealing damage to the install location. Risk can be mitigated with the use of C.A.S.E.
